title: Shion Ke Sardar Hussain Alvida
body:
ShiaO ke sardar Hussain Alvida,
Deen ke mukhtaar Hussain Alvida..
<<DIVIDER>>
Taziyaan khano se ajj, hotey hai ruqsat Imam…
Dil pe hai runjo ta-a-b, hotey hai ruqsat Imam…
Akhiri matm hai ajj, hotey hai ruqsat Imam…
<<DIVIDER>>
KeH lo Azadaar Hussain Alvida, Deen ke mukhtaar Hussain Alvida..
<<DIVIDER>>
Matami suff oth gayi, khatm Muharram howa…
Koi na ronaq rahi, khatm Muharram howa…
Puri na hasrat hoi, khatm Muharram howa…
<<DIVIDER>>
Roye Azaadar Hussain Alvida, Deen ke mukhtaar Hussain Alvida..
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta hai Shia Tamam, Haay Hussain Alvida,
Tashnalab Tashnaqaam, Haay Hussain Alvida….
Aye mere shah-e-anam, Haay Hussain Alvida….
<<DIVIDER>>
Bekas-o-lachar hussain Alvida.. Deen ke mukhtaar Hussain Alvida..
